findings.title: Byte-enable semantics underspecified: DDR-side DM polarity and read-request mask
findings.detail: data_path_mapping.byte_enable_semantics says 'wishbone_sel_per_byte' for the host side and nothing else. Two questions the spec must answer: (1) DDR-side DM polarity — the design drives ddr_dm_o = ~sel (JEDEC DDR3 DM=1 masks a byte), while a spec-derived model carries sel through unchanged; both are defensible readings of a silent spec. (2) What byte-enable accompanies a READ request internally — observed req.mask is 0 on reads (wb_sel_i not driven), a spec-derived model predicts full enables. Until the spec states both, mask comparisons on ddr_wr_beat and on read req transactions assert requirements the spec never makes; a waiver is PROPOSED for those two field comparisons and awaits owner approval (waivers require a named approver — none added unilaterally).
